title: AI training opt-out disclosure (/.well-known/ai-training-opt-out), version 1
description: A service's machine-readable statement of whether it trains AI models on its users' content, and where users can opt out. See spec/well-known-ai-training-opt-out.md.

version.description: Format version. Consumers reject documents with a version they do not support.

trains_on_user_content.description: yes: user content is used to train or improve AI models. no: it is not. conditional: only for some products, plans, regions or features; policy_url explains which.

default.description: What happens if the user does nothing. opted_in: training is on until the user opts out. opted_out: training is off unless the user opts in. no_choice: the user cannot change it.

opt_out_url.description: Page where a signed-in user can opt out (the exact setting or form). Same site as the host serving the document. Required unless trains_on_user_content is "no".

policy_url.description: The section of the privacy policy or AI terms that describes training on user content.

data_types.description: Kinds of user content used for training. Use the registered vocabulary where it fits.

regions.description: Regions where the statements in this document apply. "ALL" means everywhere. Consumers ignore codes they do not know.

last_updated.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the statements in this document were last reviewed or changed.

contact.description: Where users can send privacy questions or requests: an email address or an https URL.
